name: Lycheetah Framework
description: A public research corpus connecting nine formal frameworks, experimental Python tools, bounded agent controls, evidence and failure records, governance proposals, learning design and creative writing. Evidence and maturity vary by component.

license.name: MIT
license.component_terms: Individual documents and supplied research packets can declare their own terms; retain those notices.

package.meaning: Source-tree package version, not a claim of a new published package release.

versions.boundary: Source declarations differ in scope and in defense document totals. Preserve the disagreement; do not infer one global release number or silently amend the registers. Research packets retain their own releases.

public_routes.name: Alignment Playground
public_routes.boundary: Text-heuristic demonstration, not validated alignment detection.

public_routes.name: LAMAGUE handover preview
public_routes.boundary: Record comparison/export, not proof of truth, consent or human-understanding advantage.

public_routes.name: Earned Light and Sovereign Will public reader
public_routes.boundary: Separately hosted public reader. Source PR review and hosted deployment are separate states; generated dist is not another manuscript.

frameworks.name: CASCADE
frameworks.boundary: Synthetic/historical exercises have declared assumptions; the predictive conjecture remains a recorded failure.

frameworks.name: AURA
frameworks.purpose: Seven constitutional invariants, proxy checks and text heuristics.
frameworks.boundary: Computable proxies do not establish semantic sufficiency or safety on real traffic.

frameworks.name: LAMAGUE
frameworks.purpose: Symbolic/formal language, record compression and experimental human-language research.
frameworks.boundary: Distinct language lines have different contracts/evidence; proposed cultural mappings are not community endorsement.

frameworks.name: TRIAD
frameworks.boundary: Convergence is conditional on the model and its assumptions.

frameworks.name: MICROORCIM
frameworks.purpose: Proposed agency and intent-behavior drift constructs.
frameworks.boundary: Implementations do not establish real-world measurement validity.

frameworks.name: EARNED LIGHT
frameworks.purpose: Earlier thermodynamic analogy and consciousness theory.
frameworks.boundary: Theoretical, not an empirical consciousness theory; distinct from October agent-safety forges.

frameworks.name: ANAMNESIS
frameworks.purpose: Discovery, mathematical epistemology and convergence hypotheses.
frameworks.boundary: Philosophical/research claims require their own evidence.

frameworks.name: CHRYSOPOEIA
frameworks.boundary: Formal/experimental models, not a demonstrated human transformation guarantee.

frameworks.name: HARMONIA
frameworks.boundary: Mathematical models do not establish a theory of consciousness.

claim_summary.boundary: Repository-assigned statuses, not counts of independently validated or universally proven claims. The separate load-bearing ledger has a different scope.

other_claim_categories.meaning: Rows outside the nine named framework buckets, already included in the 71-row total.

empirical_summary.current_hosted_ci_result: Not established by this metadata refresh. Workflow configuration is not evidence of execution.
empirical_summary.boundary: Read each dated receipt for artifact, inputs, baseline, sample size, failures and unwalked limits. Externally authored data is not independent replication. Internal tests and supplied-source preservation do not establish production safety, general social benefit or a human study.

nz_governance.principle: The same six data-sovereignty rights for every New Zealander.
nz_governance.boundary: Not law, an adopted standard or implemented national service. March cultural-governance drafts are superseded direction; supporting research does not inherit current policy authority.

corpus_contract.role: Public, versioned research corpus and retrieval layer.
preserve: Source, evidence, implementation and test paths
Failures, retractions, conventional-baseline ties and unresolved objections
Distinct literary, philosophical, cultural and empirical registers
corpus_contract.boundary: Generated summaries do not silently revise canonical claims, change model weights, create automatic memory or establish private agent state.

citation.preferred: Clark, M. C. J. (2026). The Lycheetah Framework: Nine Formal Frameworks for AI Alignment and Epistemology (Version C-1.1). Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20020828
citation.boundary: Preferred citation metadata, not a claim that every later packet shares that release or has been peer reviewed.

scope_limits.summary: No claim of validated runtime alignment detection, independent empirical replication, production certification, an established consciousness theory, community endorsement or changed platform authority. Creative work and governance proposals retain their own status.

stewardship.challenge_process: GitHub Issue using the defense-challenge label; see CONTRIBUTING.md.
stewardship.boundary: No institutional successor, partnership or endorsement is inferred from an earlier outreach draft.
